screen_definition.question: Does dealer-mirror option taker-flow GEX condition next-15-minute BTC/ETH index realized volatility within the captured intraday sample?

sources.prices: captured Deribit btc_usd and eth_usd index records

screen_definition.block_definition: Aggregate taker-signed GEX by underlying and non-overlapping UTC 15-minute block; dealer-mirror GEX is the negative. Next-block realized volatility is sqrt(sum(log index return)^2) from observations inside the next 15-minute block. No overlapping outcomes.
screen_definition.truth_table: fast-screen-pass iff every sample condition and gate is observed true; falsified if sample conditions pass and any gate is false; inconclusive if a sample condition is unmet.

stopping_rule.type: event-count earliest stop; no wall clock
stopping_rule.rule: Chronologically order transitions by outcome-block end. The stop is the earliest outcome-block end at or before the derived window end at which every registered sample minimum first holds (parent find_earliest_stop, executed verbatim). Transitions ending after the stop are excluded from gates. If no such end exists inside the window, the verdict is inconclusive on the full window.
inputs_the_stop_may_read: count of GEX-computable trades in signal blocks that form transitions
count of transitions: a signal block with >=1 computable trade, nonzero dealer GEX, and an AVAILABLE next-block RV under the parent completeness rule
sign counts of dealer GEX blocks

the parent RV availability rule itself: >=720 in-block index observations, no consecutive gap >5000 ms, anchor within 5000 ms of block start, final observation within 5000 ms of block end, AND every price in the block finite and positive (a nonpositive, nonnumeric, or nonfinite captured price marks the block unavailable, no imputation)
inputs_the_stop_never_reads: any realized-volatility magnitude computed from valid prices
any correlation, ratio, or gate statistic
stopping_rule.note: RV availability is a data-integrity property. Its price-validity clause is inherited verbatim from the parent semantic amendment and is disclosed here because it inspects captured price values (validity, not magnitude): a block excluded for an invalid price is recorded in the results rv_journal with its reason. No block can be excluded because of how large or small its RV is.

observation_window.start_rule: Exactly the exclusive end of the feasibility-corrected window; shares no market-data membership with any evaluated window.
observation_window.end_rule: Largest 15-minute-aligned boundary <= min(latest trade.timestamp, latest btc_usd data.timestamp, latest eth_usd data.timestamp) inside the frozen byte prefixes. Derived by the runner from timestamps only, before any metric; recorded in the results as integrity_preconditions.window_derivation. Fails closed if any required stream is missing.
observation_window.hard_cap: The frozen byte prefixes below. No wall-clock deadline exists; the search space is bounded only by bytes captured before this contract was written.
observation_window.feasibility_assertion: The runner refuses to proceed unless 2 x (window blocks - 1) >= 12 registered transitions.
observation_window.record_boundary: Metric records use authoritative exchange timestamps >= start and < end. Deribit outcome-block end may equal end only because every raw RV observation remains < end. Receipt time is capture availability, not exchange time.

deribit_membership.signal_membership: Signal block start >= start and every contributing option trade timestamp is < end.
deribit_membership.outcome_membership: Every RV input observation is >= start and < end except the parent-permitted pre-block anchor up to 5000 ms; outcome-block end may equal end.
deribit_membership.metadata_context: instrument.creation_timestamp is exchange provenance; received_ts_ms is capture availability and must be < end for metadata eligibility.

outputs.run_budget: Exactly one outcome-producing run. The runner verifies every pin, preflights every output path (snapshot, results, owner copy), reads and hashes every prefix, derives the window, asserts feasibility, and builds instrument provenance entirely in memory; only then does it re-verify pins, load the parent module, publish the snapshot with create-only fsynced writes, compute, re-verify pins, and publish results and the owner copy create-only. An existing snapshot, result, or owner copy aborts before any input is read. A failure before the snapshot exists touched no outcome and may be fixed and rerun; a failure after the snapshot exists must be closed CRASHED and never rerun under this contract.

multiplicity: Single trial. No pooling with the parent, superseded, or corrected windows; no threshold, formula, horizon, asset, or completeness change; no rerun, extension, or re-windowing after the outcome. An inconclusive result closes this lineage FROZEN-INCONCLUSIVE; any further Deribit test requires a new owner-authorized preregistration.
